capabilities: Drag A-to-B loops on a waveform with named marks and 10 ms edge nudging
Slow tempo from 25% to 150% while keeping pitch
Shift pitch in semitones and cents independently of tempo
Play mp4 video locked to the stretched audio with zoom for watching hands
Write marks, saved loops and a dated practice log into the song's note
disambiguation: Not speech-to-text transcription; it is a music practice player for working out songs by listening.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The media folder should live outside the vault because Obsidian Sync caps files at 5 MB. Windows/Linux are untested and Android is reported not to work. The optional Claude Code skill for fetching songs needs yt-dlp, ffmpeg and deno, and downloading from YouTube violates YouTube's terms of service.
intentEvidence: Transcribe! is excellent but desktop-only. Transcribe+ needs an Apple Silicon Mac and a subscription.
motivation: Made by a guitarist who wanted to learn songs from the record, anywhere, for free, with progress stored as plain markdown on every device.
problem: Existing transcribing apps are desktop-only, subscription-gated, or keep practice progress locked in their own format instead of portable text notes.

relations.evidence: Transcribe+ needs an Apple Silicon Mac and a subscription.
Built on Signalsmith Stretch (MIT) for time-stretching and pitch-shifting.

summary: Transcribing audio and video player that loops, slows down and pitch-shifts songs, saving marks and practice logs into the song's note.
